name: crewcue
description: CrewCue monorepo: native iOS/Android clients, shared Swift client core, Fastify API

scripts.postinstall: patch-package && npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && npm run build -w @crewcue/platform-client
scripts.verify: npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && npm run build -w @crewcue/platform-client && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run agent:harness:test && npm run verify:clients && npm run verify:client-core
scripts.verify:api: npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && npm run build -w @crewcue/platform-client && npm run typecheck -w @crewcue/api && npm run test -w @crewcue/api
scripts.verify:clients: npm run verify:client-behavior && npm run verify:client-boundary && npm run verify:client-codegen
scripts.verify:contracts: npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run test -w @crewcue/contracts
